items.title: 场景参数 · 景深、辉光与完整保存恢复
items.requirements: Review live native DOF and Glow numerical controls, environment/day-dusk/cloud/other effect controls, five Chinese panel sections, keyboard/mouse operation at 1920x1080 and 1280x720, full-profile atomic save/load/reset, fresh-start restore and read-only migration of legacy cloud settings including 70 percent contrast / 48 percent density. Validate the complete runtime and verification-source fingerprints, unchanged original r4 assets and explicit r4 parent Revision and review round. Fifteen original GPU frames cover focused effects, persistence and UI; the runtime suite records its physical-route regression, while previous GPU route captures and calibrated radiometry remain historical. Technical checks do not grant aesthetic approval or stage admission.
